feed.title: Awesome DSH Plugin — Curated DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Plugin List

entry.title: GLFzr/dsh-drop-file-to-path
entry.summary: Codex-style drag-drop: drag any file into the DSH web GUI, it lands in ~/.dsh-dropbox, and the path is inserted into the composer as a whole blue chip.

entry.title: FengHuoLinShan/dsh-plugin-llm-balance
entry.summary: Draggable floating card showing the balance/quota of your most recently used providers (DeepSeek/Moonshot/Kimi For Coding): auto-discovery, color-coded tiers, live refresh.

entry.title: chinaRXQ/dsh-wallpaper
entry.summary: Wallpaper skin for the DSH Web UI: image background with opacity, mask and blur controls.

entry.title: ishuowang/dsh-agent-team-room
entry.summary: Persistent rooms for independent DSH Agent sessions, with explicit membership, direct and broadcast messages, tracked tasks, and a shared Web timeline.

entry.title: Edge-Echo/dsh-mcp-bridge
entry.summary: Curated, verified MCP server bundle: one install brings demo, memory, filesystem, GitHub, Playwright and remote HTTP MCP servers, plus a connectivity verifier tool and CI checks.

entry.title: linxichen/dsh-rigorquant
entry.summary: RigorQuant preset + skill pack: unattended walled multi-agent research for empirical and computational mathematics (economics, finance, portfolio), with a four-part pre-implementation check battery and a jacobian/Lean escalation lane.

entry.title: xmanrui/dsh-weixin
entry.summary: Connect a Weixin bot to DeepSeek Harness by scanning a QR code.

entry.title: xmanrui/dsh-im
entry.summary: Connect IM bots to DeepSeek Harness by scanning QR codes (supports Feishu, Weixin, DingTalk, and more).

entry.title: Noob-stupid/dsh-github-login
entry.summary: Visual GitHub login without a terminal: in-window device flow, token synced into the gh CLI, and host status/launch endpoints.

entry.title: labmimors/dsh-mcp-lens
entry.summary: Progressive-disclosure MCP gateway that searches large remote catalogs through `mcp_search`, then invokes exact schemas through `mcp_call` with lazy connections and bounded caches.

entry.title: Cavan-Ou/dsh-observation-journal
entry.summary: Zero-touch runtime telemetry for DSH: every session auto-writes task, model tier, tools, failures, duration, status into a human-readable journal with a stats section (pure observer — no tools, no LLM calls, no injection).

entry.title: tianyaZTY/dsh-hot-plugin-host
entry.summary: Runtime plugin loading for the Web UI: a watched hot directory installs/updates client-plugin bundles live on every open page, no restart. Includes a right-column subagent dashboard example.

entry.title: 609476965/dsh-LorebookMD
entry.summary: Import SillyTavern/TavernAI character cards and world books, save them as local Markdown lore documents, and generate novel prose from your prompts with the world settings as reference.

entry.title: liqichen/dsh-plugin-manager
entry.summary: GUI in the DSH settings panel: toggle/delete MCP servers, browse and trash skills, and list built-in plugin packages — hot-applied without restart.

entry.title: starslittle/dsh-blue-whale
entry.summary: DeepSeek-Chat-style blue-whale skin: brand #4D6BFE on light and dark, following the built-in appearance.

entry.title: PwnKY/dsh-session-link
entry.summary: Copy and open `dsh://` session deep links, or paste them into another conversation to inject a bounded, read-only snapshot of the referenced session.

entry.title: huguangyu666/dsh-plugin-session-import
entry.summary: Import claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode chat history into dsh sessions: workspace binding, tool calls preserved, oversized-session protection, zcode compaction restore.

entry.title: huguangyu666/dsh-plugin-notify
entry.summary: Notification outbox: agent proactively notifies via toast / Chinese TTS voice / sound effects (explosion, victory, alarm), 60s confirmation window voice-calls you back, volume boost, settings panel.

entry.title: huguangyu666/dsh-store
entry.summary: Plugin store: npm authoritative catalog + awesome curated list (550+ plugins, 11 categories), dsh-field quality verification, official `dsh plugin add/remove` one-click install, sidebar + settings entry.

entry.title: GLFzr/dsh-opencode-go-quota
entry.summary: OpenCode Go quota ring: click-to-cycle progress ring (5h/weekly/monthly) left of the model selector, colored by urgency, with reset countdowns on hover.

entry.title: ZichengGurrr/dsh-window#plugin
entry.summary: Native Windows desktop window (WebView2) for DSH: one-command install, auto-fetches the app zip from GitHub Releases, creates a desktop shortcut, and adds a desktop_launch tool to start it from chat.

entry.title: Realyujie/dsh-us-stocks
entry.summary: US stock quotes, price history, financial statements, analyst consensus and news via yahoo-finance2.

entry.title: SaiSenBox/dsh-boot-guard
entry.summary: Loader-independent startup recovery for DSH Web that detects likely broken plugins, temporarily skips them, and restores only Boot Guard-managed changes.

entry.title: AcidGr/dsh-web-mobile-fix
entry.summary: Mobile layout fixes for the Web UI on narrow screens: full-screen settings panel, one-row plugin nav, full-screen sidebar, centered popups, icon-only session-log button.

entry.title: AcidGr/dsh-web-lan-access
entry.summary: LAN/remote access for the Web UI: injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill on plain-HTTP origins so the frontend survives LAN or Tailscale IP direct links.

entry.title: Bernardxu123/dsh-mobile-gate
entry.summary: LAN mobile gateway: isolated child-process reverse proxy with first-visit approval, per-device token binding, rate limiting, and mobile layout injection (compact composer pills, randomUUID polyfill).

entry.title: Noob-stupid/dsh-plugin-hub
entry.summary: A plugin management panel: one-click enable/disable for installed plugins plus a GitHub dsh-plugin marketplace with details and one-click installs.

entry.title: Make0209/dsh-usage-stats
entry.summary: GitHub-style usage heatmap dashboard: per-workspace turn counts and token spend (with cache-hit rate), DeepSeek account balance, and workspace aliases.

entry.title: zoumutou/dsh-cost-balance
entry.summary: Collapsible iOS-style stats pill under the composer: session cost, DeepSeek account balance, cache-hit rate, and token usage in a frosted panel.

entry.title: bowenliang123/dsh-context
entry.summary: Context insight panel: see what the model's context window is made of and how it evolves — composition vs. window size, per-request history, compression/injection events, and per-message token stats.
